🧱 ELI5 Kata · Bloxorz Solver (Haskell + ASM, 3 kyu)

How do you roll a 1×1×2 block across a floating island from B into the square hole X in the fewest moves without tipping over the edge?

https://github.com/8b-is/space-bender/tree/main/katas/3kyu/bloxorz-solver

🎲 ELI5 Step 1 (3 Poses of a Domino Block):

At any moment the block has 1 of 3 poses:
• `Upright r c`: standing tall on 1 tile
• `Horz r c`: lying flat across `(r, c)` & `(r, c+1)`
• `Vert r c`: lying flat across `(r, c)` & `(r+1, c)`
Tipping upright shifts 2 tiles; rolling flat shifts 1!

⚡ ELI5 Step 2 (Haskell `Seq` BFS + 12-Bit Assembly Moat):

In Haskell (`solution.hs`), `Data.Sequence` BFS finds the shortest path.
In x86-64 NASM & ARM64 (`solution.asm`, `solution_arm64.s`), a 32×32 zero-moat grid packs `(orient << 10) | idx` into 12 bits with branchless LUT rolls!

✅ Verified in Haskell (GHC) + x86-64 NASM + Apple Silicon ARM64!
